title: 'We're Going To Keep It': President Donald Trump Confirms US Will Retain Seized Venezuelan Oil
description: President Trump confirmed that the United States will retain control of recently seized Venezuelan oil, signaling a firm stance against Caracas. While the exact use—whether resale, domestic use, or adding to strategic reserves—is undecided, Washington will not return the oil. Trump also mentioned talks with major US oil firms about Venezuela’s energy sector amid ongoing sanctions.
